contentText: Iran has confirmed the deaths of two senior security officials, considered among the most powerful figures in the country, in overnight strikes: Ali Larijani, secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, and General Gholamreza Soleimani, head of the Revolutionary Guard’s Basij force. It's a major blow to Iran’s complicated security apparatus. FRANCE 24's Emerald Maxwell takes a look at how it works
